text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, while shopping at the mall, I 
ran into Sweep Tosho by chance.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh? You... Fufun, perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Meeting here must be fate! Carry my bags 
for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Appointed as Sweep Tosho's luggage 
carrier, I ended up accompanying her 
around the shops!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The kimono arrived, you see. You know, the 
one I'm wearing for the thank-you photo to 
Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I came here to buy accessories to match 
it, but... Ugh, I'm so tired from walking 
around!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have a professional pick out the 
sash and stuff. Hey, go find the kimono 
section for me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I want to see every single obi sash and 
accessory that would look good on me!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
My, what a cute little customer! Well 
then, how about something like this~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What the store clerk brought out were 
adorable pastel-colored sashes and 
accessories.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
This pink ribbon-patterned obi is very 
popular, and it's elastic so it won't feel 
tight at all, even for a young girl like 
you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
And this sash clip... it's a badge you 
fasten to your obi. It has sparkling 
jewels and is super popular with kids 
around your age~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...I don't want any of this!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I asked for something that 
suits me... all they show me is childish 
stuff! They're treating me like a little 
kid!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(I'm a proud, magnificent witch! Why can't 
anyone understand that?!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? Wait, did something like this 
happen before—)

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
(No! No, no, no, no! Why won't anybody 
understand?!!)

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
(It's not that I hate it being stuffy! 
I... I just—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, what's the matter, Sweepy? You're 
in quite a sour mood, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. Back then... Grandma wore a 
crisp, elegant iris-purple kimono, paired 
with a calm mustard-yellow obi.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(It looked so grown-up and cool... But my 
kimono was a pastel pink, far from looking 
like a real witch.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Seeing that difference made me feel... so 
embarrassed and frustrated.)

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Um, little lady...? Would you prefer not 
to look after all...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...No, I won't quit. I want to see 
something more grown-up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Proud, mature... Do you have anything that 
screams 'super cool witch'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the clerk brought out plenty 
of mature-looking items... and Sweep Tosho 
was able to finish her shopping without a 
hitch.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, so that's all it took. If I just say 
I want mature stuff, they'll bring it 
right out.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Back when I was little... Maybe I 
should have just said it properly like 
that.
choice_data_list:
If you could say it today, maybe that 
means you've grown.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grown~? Hmph, listen to you acting all 
high and mighty!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. I won't scold you 
today.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because I've... grown into an adult, after 
all!
